notes.title: Version 1.47.0 Update Notice
notes.notes: [p]Updates:[/p][p]1. The limited-time Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire collab event will start on 8/1 (UTC)! After the update, Elite Supplies can be claimed for 7 consecutive days to help you prepare for the collab![/p][p]2. Added Hero Chronicles, a new feature that unlocks bonus attributes and item rewards based on your progress in developing Legendary Heroes[/p][p]3. New Ranged Heroes: "Phantom of the Capital" Cedric & "Style Maven" Spectra. Commanders will be able to meet the new Heroes on 8/11 (UTC)[/p][p]4. Added Commander Namecard Skins. Use Namecard Skins to change the appearance of your profile[/p][p]5. Added Gift Center to the Mall (unlocked at VIP 7). You can purchase and use Gift Coins to send packs to friends or allies[/p][p]6. Optimized Garrisons: Can now set specific troop types when garrisoning[/p][p]7. Added Alliance Notice board (General Notices and Voting Notices) to facilitate Alliance management. Adjusted Police Station Hero Release Schedule:[/p][p]1) The guaranteed Legendary Hero awarded after 50 draws for new Commanders has been changed from Louis to Cynthia Calamity[/p][p]2) Cynthia Calamity will be the initial Hero available at the Police Station[/p][p]3) Cynthia Calamity, Lee Seung-Won, Nakano Maaya, Louis, Raigoro, and Tom will be added progressively to the Police Station search rewards as Commanders progress in the game. (The Heroes available in the Police Station may vary depending on each Commander's game progress. Please check in-game for the Heroes available to you.)[/p][p]13. notes.title: Version 1.46.5 Update Notice
notes.notes: [p]Greetings, Commander.[/p][p]A new update is here! Doomsday: Last Survivors will tentatively undergo maintenance to implement the latest game update on {$1} (UTC). We apologize for any inconvenience caused. As compensation, we'll be sending you a reward after the maintenance.[/p][p]Please download the latest version after the maintenance to experience the new features.[/p][p]Updates:[/p][p]1. Off-Limits War (Beta) Optimizations:[/p][p]   1) A new Ranged combat unit, the Autonomous Mech, joins the battlefield! The Autonomous Mech Alpha will spawn at minutes 7 and 17, while the Autonomous Mech Beta will only spawn at minute 17. Once defeated, players can control the Autonomous Mech, which deals extra damage to buildings, adding more strategic depth to the battlefield.[/p][p]   2) Improved the Strength calculation method by removing the impact of previous match rankings on Strength.[/p][p]   3) Added a new battle time slot: 8:00 - 8:35 (UTC), catering to more players’ battle needs at different times.[/p][p]   4) Optimized UI[/p][p]2. Honor Emblem/Gunfire Gala events will now start every Sunday (previously every Monday)[/p][p]3. Improved win/loss rewards for participants in The Recovery of Pompeii[/p][p]4. Other bug fixes and optimizations[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.41.0 Update Notice
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44295691/4b34beaebc45a91359f50055dc9aef562361ac3f.png[/img]Updates:
1. New Beast Chip system
   1) Biochemical Beasts can equip 6 different types of Chips, each providing unique attribute bonuses.
   2) Equipping a full set of Chips will activate corresponding Array effects, offering a variety of bonuses and even additional passive skill effects.
   3) Chips can be ranked up. When a full set of Chips ranks up to a required level, the Array effects will be enhanced.
   4) Chips equipped on Support Biochemical Beasts can also provide buffs to the Leader Biochemical Beast, with the same Inheritance ratio as the Support Biochemical Beast.
2. Wasteland Challenge events upgrade to the Biohazard Frenzy event on 3/17 (UTC)
   1) During the event, consume Bio-stabilizers in Off-Limits Exploration to unlock new exploration areas and slots.
   2) Deploy Biochemical Beasts to vacant slots in exploration areas to accumulate Protovirus Fragments. You have a chance to obtain Off-Limits Zone Passes when collecting the fragments from the Biochemical Beasts, which can be used in the Off-Limits Roulette for rich rewards.
   3) Each area has designated Biochemical Beasts. Deploy the specified Biochemical Beasts to the exploration slots to earn double Protovirus Fragments.
   4) At the end of the event, Commanders will be ranked based on the number of Protovirus Fragments they own and receive corresponding rewards.
   5) Main items from the Lethal Outbreak and Grand Revival events (such as Rifle Ammo and Reviving Hammer) will be converted into Gold Ammocoins and Wasteland Ammocoins after the maintenance at the following rates:
     - Wasteland Ammocoin: Every Rifle Ammo and Reviving Hammer will be converted into 1 Wasteland Ammocoin at a 1:1 ratio.
     - Gold Ammocoin: Depending on your rank at the end of the Wasteland Challenge at 0:00, 3/10 (UTC), every Rifle Ammo and Reviving Hammer will be converted into Gold Ammocoins at the following ratios, rounded up to the nearest whole number.
   6) From 3/17 (UTC), the Wasteland Challenge's exchange shop will be temporarily open at the main interface of the Biohazard Frenzy event for 30 days, to ensure that Commanders can successfully exchange for Wasteland Ammocoin and Gold Ammocoin. Wasteland currency will be removed when the shop closes, so please exchange them in time to avoid any losses.
3. Limited-time Doomsday: Last Survivors Capybara 2nd anniversary celebration from 3/15 (UTC)
4. New Rider Heroes "Bloodhunt Maiden" Rubina & "Icescape Howler" Daryl. Commanders will be able to meet the new Heroes on 3/24 (UTC).
5. New Squad Skin: Underworld Gatekeeper
6. New Miyamoto Doichi Hero Skin: Worldly Samurai
7. New Legendary Fire-type Biochemical Beast: Kirin
8. Added a Biochemical Beasts section to the Bag for easy viewing of Biochemical Beast-related upgrade items
9. Beast Invasion: Added up to Area 100, totaling 1,000 stages
10. Origin of Beasts: Added Clue Store for item exchange
11. Other bug fixes and optimizations

notes.title: Version 1.36.0 Update Notice
notes.notes:
Updates:
1. Island Raid remake opens for registrations from 12/4 (UTC). Please update the game to access.
 1) Gameplay and map adjustments
 a) New Coin Plunder gameplay 
- Outposts produce Prism Coins from the second day of the event. Alliances can declare war to plunder Prism Coins from Outposts belonging to other Alliances.
- Declaring war: War can only be declared on Outposts, During the event, Alliances can directly attack and raid the Outpost they have declared war upon, regardless of whether their territories are connected.
- Temporary Helipad: During the war declaration period, Alliances can construct a Temporary Helipad at any location on the map to allow Alliance members to relocate near it. The Temporary Helipad will incinerate after the declaration period ends. 
- Plundered Prism Coins will be included in the combined Coin Rankings from the third day of the event and counted in the event rankings.
 b) Added Miasma Zone: A new Miasma Zone has been added to the center of the map. Players can't construct Watchtowers in the Miasma Zone or relocate Shelters there. The Miasma Zone will dissipate once the required buildings are open.
 c) Added Speed Rescue: During the event, Elixir Heal will be added to the Hospital, that allows you to use Rescue Elixirs to immediately heal wounded units. While evacuating, 65% of wounded Troops in the Hospital will be returned , and the Aid Station will return a percentage of lost Troops daily.
 d) War Meets War adjustment: The original War Meets War event will be converted into an Island Trial event that grants Trial Coins, An Island Store will also be added.
 2) Rule adjustments
 a) Duration: The event duration will be changed to 3 days.
 b) Registration: Alliances with 50 or more active members with Shelter Lv 16 or above can register to take part.
 c) Warzone division: Alliances will be split into three Warzones based on Alliance Might
 - Apex Warzone (Ranks 1-32)
 - Elite Warzone (Ranks 33-256)
 - Fearless Warzone (Ranks 257-2200)
 - Other Alliances will not be able to participate
 d) Alliance Building Materials production: Helipads continuously produce Alliance Building Materials. Occupy settlements to increase their production.
 3) Other optimizations
 a) Added battle participation preference system: Alliance members can state their preference in participating in battles, and Alliance Officers can consider their preferences when registering for war events.
 b) Added Alliance coalitions: Alliances can form coalitions. Once formed, the other Alliances in the coalition will be marked in a special color, and will be protected from attacks during field battles to prevent accidental friendly fire.
 c) Added a new Merit Award system. Alliance Leaders can distribute Merit Chests to Alliance members based on their performance.
2. Hero Upgrade adjustments
 1) Hero levels will no longer be limited by Hero Star Ranks. Instead, Hero levels will be limited by the Headquarters level after the update. 
 2) Adjusted the base Squad Capacity values ​​for each Headquarters level (the capacity at maximum level remains unchanged at 150,000 Troops.)
 3) The Squad Capacity of Assistant Heroes will take effect on expeditions. Assistant Heroes increase Squad Capacity by 50% of Leader Heroes of the same level. (E.g. a Lv 60 Hero can have 50,000 Troops in their Squad as a Leader, but can only have 25,000 Troops when as an Assistant.)
3. Hero Source adjustments: including Heroes obtained from Police Station searches, Memory Trip and Memory Store, Radar Station Store, and weekly Elite Hero events. 
4. Hero Design adjustment: Seo Ji-na will be replaced by Norah after the update. The Hero Talents, skills, and ways to obtain her will remain unchanged. 
5. Thanksgiving event from 11/25 (UTC)
6. All-Star Night matchmaking optimizations: Matchmaking for Splendid Stele and Top Commander will be separate.
7. District Showdown optimizations
 1) Increased the number of Mysterious Merchants to two, and added a new Gem pack
 2) Improved District Alley rewards
 3) Optimized other user experience details
8. New Squad Skin: Thor's Hammer
9. Ace Survivor optimizations: After the Auto Gather duration ends, the Squad will complete gathering the current Resource Node before returning to the Shelter. 
10. Optimized the sound effect of the B.Duck Squad Skin on the map
11. Other bug fixes and optimizations

notes.title: Version 1.35.0 Update Notice
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1032924240300744774/1259800908246814741/1920x340.png?ex=671c0b46&is=671ab9c6&hm=8bac6f554c5a4b6f0340dec872cfcd8b44bc8dc12c2c26c48d64fccaf007d857&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=960&height=170[/img]
Updates:
1. Limited-time B.Duck collaboration from Nov 1 (UTC)
2. Unlocked Alliance Escort in Doomsday Express
3. New District Showdown gameplay:
 1) Registration: When the Federation history reaches requirements, Alliances with more than 40 active members with Shelter Lv 12 or above can register to take part. 
 2) Warzone division: Alliances will be split into three Warzones based on Alliance Might
  - Apex Warzone (Ranks 1-60)
  - Elite Warzone (Ranks 61-240)
  - Fearless Warzone (Ranks 241-2100)
  - Other Alliances will not be able to participate
 3) Exploration: Roll Silver Dice to explore. Silver Dice are restored over time. You can also roll Gold Dice to explore and choose to move a specific number of spaces.
 4) Occurrences: A variety of occurrences will happen while exploring, including District buffs, District Statues, Street Gangs, and the chance to enter District Alleys.
 5) Funds: While exploring, you can obtain Personal Funds and Alliance Funds. Personal Funds count toward personal rankings, while Alliance Funds count toward Alliance rankings. You can also raid Alliance Funds from other Alliances during the event.
 6) Merit Awards: Alliance Leaders can distribute Merit Chests to Alliance members based on their performance.
4. New Legendary Infantry Heroes "Spirit Exorcist" Bodala and "Brilliant Star" Stella. Commanders will be able to meet the new Heroes on Nov 4 (UTC).
5. New Alliance League tier: Super Ace
6. New 1-day hold period for Gold added to the Alliance Vault. The Gold can be distributed after the hold period.
7. Split Gold into Paid Gold and Linked Gold. Linked Gold can't be donated to Alliance Vaults.
8. Optimized Ace and Common Survivors
9. Fixed Might display in Doomsday Express
10. Other bug fixes and optimizations

notes.title: Version 1.34.0 Update Notice
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1032924240300744774/1259800908246814741/1920x340.png?ex=6706f346&is=6705a1c6&hm=dac42310cfdfaf3ff8a4faa46c820956117906e03eddf23b0190d5481acb8be3&[/img]

[b]Updates:[/b]
1. New Doomsday Express feature
 1) New building: Shipment Center. The Shipment Center unlocks at Headquarters Lv 8, while the Doomsday Express feature unlocks when the Federation history reaches 4 days.
 2) Commanders can initiate personal escorts at the Shipment Center and deploy a Hero to protect the vehicle. Safely reach the destination to earn loads of rewards.
 3) Others can raid your vehicle during the escort. You will not lose Troops during Raid battles.
2. New Survivor system
 1) Recruit Survivors to gain attribute bonuses
 2) Some Survivors share a bond. Collect Survivors that share a bond to gain additional boosts.
 3) Heroes can form Tactical Teams with Survivors to gain attribute bonuses.
 4) Ace Survivors not only provide attribute bonuses, but also unlock automatic operations such as Auto Gather, Auto Hunt, and Auto Rallies.
3. Julia's Magic Cards: Added automatic functions and simplified operations.
4. Construction and research upgrades: Added a Replenish All button for resources.
5. Hospital: Added Quick Use function for Speedups.
6. Mall purchase points: Purchase points will no longer be displayed when there is no ongoing purchase event.
7. New Game Entrustment system: Meet entrustment requirements to discuss with another player, come to an agreement for the entrustment, and help or get help with managing your account and battles.
8. New Alliance Vault: The Alliance Vault gains Gold when members make purchases, and the Alliance Leader and Treasurer will distribute them to members.

notes.title: Version 1.33.0 Update Notice
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1032924240300744774/1259800908246814741/1920x340.png?ex=66ce42c6&is=66ccf146&hm=d959d03d787a0f29649045581747ed7c1f7fdea8209b1ddd62a975450fb17a43&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1440&height=255[/img]

[b]Updates:[/b]

1. Top Commander will be part of the All-Star Night themed event from 9/9 (UTC). Please update the game to access.
 1) This themed event consists of three sub-events: Splendid Stele, Top Commander, and Great Hunter. Commanders can earn separate rankings and rewards in each event, and all rewards will be sent at the end of the All-Star Night themed event.
 2) Adjusted the daily activities for each Phase of the three events.
 3) Matchmaking for the All-Star Night themed event will be on an individual basis.
 4) Added Energy Cores as Splendid Stele rewards. They are used to upgrade Doomsday Weapons of Superheroes.
 5) Added All-Star Badges. Participate in the event to obtain them and exchange them for rewards at the All-Star Store.
2. Legendary Hero Transcendence and Superheroes:
 1) Doomsday Weapon: Take part in the new Top Commander event to obtain Energy Cores, and use them to upgrade Doomsday Weapons of Superheroes. Chasey's Energy Core will be obtainable through the Top Commander event that begins on 9/9 (UTC).
 2) Skill Transcendence: Every time you level up a Doomsday Weapon, you can use Hero Fragments of the corresponding Hero to transcend 1 Skill.
3. Archipelago Raid optimizations
 1) Warzone division: Alliances will be split into three Warzones based on Alliance Might
  - Apex Warzone (Ranks 1-100)
  - Elite Warzone (Ranks 101-500)
  - Fearless Warzone (Ranks 501-2200)
  - Other Alliances will not be able to participate
  - Increased rewards for the Apex and Elite Warzones
 2) Added a new Merit Award system. Alliance Leaders can distribute Merit Chests to Alliance members based on their performance.
  - Merit Chests come in various grades: Grand, Legendary, Epic, and Elite. There is a limited number of chests for each grade. Each member can only be allocated one Merit Chest per event.
  - Merit Chests have a distribution period and can't be distributed after it ends.
  - Alliance members must be in the Alliance participating in the event to receive Merit Chests.
 3) Added new Alliance Might rankings during the registration period for the convenience of Alliances.
4. Genesis War optimizations
 1) Looser participation criteria: instead of the top 2,000 on the Alliance Might rankings, the top 2,200 can participate.
 2) Added a new Merit Award system. Alliance Leaders can distribute Merit Chests to Alliance members based on their performance.
 3) Added new Alliance Might rankings during the registration period for the convenience of Alliances.
5. New Hero Skins: Catherine-Cyber Sweetheart, Cynthia-Ball Phantom
6. New Armaments: Gravity Propeller, Gravity Controller. They can be obtained from Merit Chests in the new Merit Award system.
7. Workshop: Increased maximum level of T3 Devices from Lv 15 to Lv 25.
8. New Squad Skin: Winged Centaur
9. Simplified controls for daily Missions and Radar Station events
10. Other bug fixes and optimizations

notes.title: Version 1.32.0 Update Notice
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1032924240300744774/1259800908246814741/1920x340.png?ex=668d0086&is=668baf06&hm=6dc905b19646e41c991ae195a85b98cb22aac9e8c6e8deca415fb327ec220972&[/img]

[b]Updates:[/b]

1. The Arena of Doom will undergo a big change at 0:00, 7/15 (UTC). In the new version of Arena of Doom, you will face challenges from Commanders from all regions and win even more rewards. Please update the game to access.
 1) The new Arena of Doom is divided into the Arena of Freedom and the Arena of Glory. Your initial tier will be allocated based on your current Might.
 2) The Arena of Doom tallies results and resets on a weekly basis. Commanders that stay above Platinum rank with more than 3,000 points in the Arena of Freedom before the end of a season will be promoted to the Arena of Glory in the next season.
 3) You will receive Demise Coins based on your ranking or tier at specific intervals. Demise Coins can be used to redeem items at the Arena Store. Demise Coins will be cleared at the end of the season.
 4) Generous rewards related to Hero Armaments will be added to the new Arena Store. They can be redeemed with Demise Coins.
 5) The current version of the Arena of Doom will close at 0:00, 7/15 (UTC). The Arena Store will be available and remain open until 23:59, 7/28 (UTC). Please use your Doom Coins before it closes. During this period, redemption requirements will be removed from the original Arena Store, and the reward redemption limit will be increased. Resource packs that can be redeemed an unlimited number of times will also be added.
2. New Hero Skin system. Get unique Hero appearances, while enhancing some Hero skills. New Louis Hero Skin: Midnight Baron is here!
3. Genesis War optimizations from 7/19 (UTC). (Please update the game to access. Additionally, Island Raid will return for a limited time from 7/10-7/14 (UTC).)
 1) Warzones: Alliances will be split into three warzones based on Alliance Might, and the reward distribution will be adjusted accordingly.
   - Apex Warzone (Ranks 1-64)
   - Elite Warzone (Ranks 65-256)
   - Fearless Warzone (Ranks 257-2000)
 2) Central zone opening times:
   - 4:00 - 5:00 (UTC)
   - 14:00 - 15:00 (UTC)
   - On the last day of battle, the central zone of ​​the innermost Ring will open for contest only once a day, from 14:00 - 16:00 (UTC).
 3) Rewards:
   - Alliances that advance to the innermost ring will have their victory rewards adjusted to Rank 1-4 rewards based on their points ranking.
   - Boosted tier and ranking rewards for War Meets War.
 4) Superweapons: Superweapons can be obtained through the Buffed Hunt event and will be at maximum level, without the need for additional upgrades.
 5) Rally time: In Genesis War, the time required for a Rally will be shortened to optimize your gaming experience.
4. Added Archipelago Raid personal rating system. Redeem rare rewards in the Rating store based on your battlefield performance rating.
5. Optimized Squad display in The Recovery of Pompeii. Your Squads will be green, allied Squads will be blue, and enemy Squads will be red.
6. Added a third Construction Queue perk to the 30-Day Premium Pass to speed up Shelter development.
7. Added the Legendary Gathering Hero, Sara Vandermeer, to the Radar Station Store.
8. Radiant Games events from 07/19-07/31 (UTC)
9. New Troop Skin: Infantry Squad - Bio Warrior
10. Optimized description of Chasey's Passive Skill "Lashing Whip". The actual skill effect is not changed.
11. Other bug fixes and optimizations
